title: ι : X' → G ×^P X' is a cellular embedding (poset form)
body_html:
$\iota$ is a cellular embedding (poset form)

Fix the induction data $(G', P)$ satisfying (P0)–(P2) and the induced space $X = G \times^P X'$ (cf.\ [[node:equivariant_sheaves.induction_GxP_X]]). Define $\iota : X' \to X$ by $E \mapsto [(1, E)]_\sim$.

This node isolates the combinatorial content of "$\iota$ is a cellular embedding" and "the $G$-action on $X$ is cellular" that lives entirely at the level of the face poset — no topology.

Lemma (cellular embedding).

  1. (Injectivity) $\iota$ is injective on $X'$.
  2. (Order preservation and reflection) For $E, F \in [\![X']\!]$, $$\iota E \preceq \iota F \iff E \preceq F.$$
  3. ($G'$-equivariance) For $n \in G'$ and $E \in [\![X']\!]$, $$n \cdot \iota E \;=\; \iota(n \cdot E).$$
  4. (Coverage) Every cell of $X$ has the form $g \cdot \iota E$ for some $g \in G$, $E \in [\![X']\!]$.
  5. (Cell equality) For $g_1, g_2 \in G$ and $E, F \in [\![X']\!]$, $$g_1 \cdot \iota E \;=\; g_2 \cdot \iota F \;\iff\; \exists\, n \in G',\ n \cdot E = F \text{ and } g_1^{-1} g_2 n \in P_E.$$
  6. (Face relation) With the same data, $$g_1 \cdot \iota E \preceq g_2 \cdot \iota F \;\iff\; \exists\, n \in G',\ n \cdot E \preceq F \text{ and } g_1^{-1} g_2 n \in P_E.$$
proof_html:
(1) Injectivity. If $\iota E = \iota F$ then $(1, E) \sim (1, F)$ in $G \times X'$: there exists $n \in G'$ with $n \cdot E = F$ and $n \in P_E$. By (P2), $n \in P_E \cap G' \Rightarrow n \in \Fix_{G'}(E)$, so $F = n \cdot E = E$.

(2) Order preservation. ($\Leftarrow$) If $E \preceq F$ then $(1, E)$ and $(1, F)$ satisfy the definition of the face relation on $G \times X'$ used to build $X$ (see clause (6) proof below), giving $\iota E \preceq \iota F$. ($\Rightarrow$) From (6) applied with $g_1 = g_2 = 1$: $\exists n \in G'$ with $n \cdot E \preceq F$ and $n \in P_E$. Then $n \in G' \cap P_E \subseteq \Fix_{G'}(E)$ by (P2), so $n \cdot E = E$, giving $E \preceq F$.

(3) $G'$-equivariance. For $n \in G'$, $n \cdot [(1, E)] = [(n, E)]$ and $[(1, n \cdot E)]$ are $\sim$-equivalent: take the witness $m := n \in G'$, then $m \cdot E = n \cdot E$ and $n^{-1} \cdot 1 \cdot m = 1 \in P_E$.

(4) Coverage. Every $q \in X$ is of the form $[(g, E)]$ for some $(g, E) \in G \times X'$, which equals $g \cdot \iota E$.

(5) Cell equality. ($\Rightarrow$) $g_1 \cdot \iota E = g_2 \cdot \iota F$ means $(g_1, E) \sim (g_2, F)$, which by definition of $\sim$ is exactly the existence of $n \in G'$ with $n \cdot E = F$ and $g_1^{-1} g_2 n \in P_E$. ($\Leftarrow$) Direct from the definition.

(6) Face relation. The face relation on $X$ is defined by descending the face relation on $G \times X'$ $$(g_1, E) \preceq_G (g_2, F) \iff \exists n \in G',\ n \cdot E \preceq F \text{ and } g_1^{-1} g_2 n \in P_E$$ through the quotient. Well-definedness (independence of representatives) uses (P0) (cosheaf monotonicity: $E \preceq F \Rightarrow P_F \le P_E$). The stated iff is the definition after descent. $\square$

Downstream

Clauses (1)–(6) equip $X$ with the structures used everywhere below:

  • $\iota$ is order-reflecting and order-preserving → the pushed-forward $G$-cell-complex structure on $X$ (CW structure and QFD property on G ×^P X' instance stack).
  • Cell equality (5) is the technical content of the cell-intersection lemma used in the QFD proof (X' is a quasi-fundamental domain of the induced space).
  • Face relation (6) is used to descend cosheaves from $X'$ to $X$ (cf.\ pushforward cosheaf in Reduction of G-equivariant cosheaves to a QFD).

Lean formalization

Each clause of the lemma has a dedicated declaration; all live in SheafOnBuilding.Induction and pertain to iota d : X' → InducedSpace d where d : InductionDatum X'.

Clause Lean declaration Uses
(1) iota_injective : Function.Injective (iota d) (P2)
(2) iota_le_iff : iota d E ≤ iota d F ↔ E ≤ F (P2) (⇐ side)
(3) iota_smul_of_mem_G' : n ∈ d.G' → n • iota d E = iota d (n • E) (P1)
(4) exists_eq_smul_iota : ∀ q, ∃ g E, q = g • iota d E quotient surj
(5) smul_iota_eq_smul_iota_iff InductionRel def
(6) smul_iota_le_smul_iota_iff descent (via InductionLe_*_descends, both use (P0))

The face relation on InducedSpace d is defined as the descent of InductionLe : (G × X') → (G × X') → Prop through the setoid InductionRel.setoid; the well-definedness lemmas InductionLe_left_descends and InductionLe_right_descends both invoke (P0). Antisymmetry is InductionLe_antisymm and combines (P2) with the equality form (5). The full PartialOrder, AbstractCellComplex, and GCellComplex instances on InducedSpace d build on these six lemmas.

theorem smul_iota_eq_smul_iota_iff (g₁ g₂ : G) (E F : X') :
    g₁ • iota d E = g₂ • iota d F ↔
      ∃ n ∈ d.G', n • E = F ∧ g₁⁻¹ * g₂ * n ∈ d.P E

      ∃ n ∈ d.G', n • E ≤ F ∧ g₁⁻¹ * g₂ * n ∈ d.P E
